This document outlines the testing procedures P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.

The Micromho static distance protection scheme is designed 
for high speed
phase and earth fault protection for high voltage and EHV over head transmission 
lines. Three zones of protection are provided, each of individual
Settings, zones 1 and 2 having polarized mho characteristics and zone 
3 having offset mho characteristic.

sections.text:
Prior to Starting Testing 
Procedure Ensure the Following Steps

items:
Look at the 
 EEHC panel nameplate and check that this EEHC system designation 
 nameplate agrees with the line that has been taken out of service for 
 maintenance.
Check there is no AC current from CT's by using a clip on ammeter.
Check there is no AC voltage from VT's by using a voltmeter.

Connect the 
 XS92a test set.

Connect test plug 1V as shown in figure 
 (a) and test plug 2V as shown in figure (b).

Ensure that the CT secondary is correctly short circuited on the case side 
 of test plug 1V
These connections must be made before the test plug is inserted.

Connect the current terminals IA, IB, 
 IC and IN on the test plug to the corresponding current terminals on the test 
 set.

Connect the voltage terminals VA, VB, VC and VN on the test plug to the 
 corresponding voltage terminals on the test set.
Remove relay isolating plugs 1V and 2V.
Insert the test plug 1V and 2V in the relay.

sections.text:
Test Trip all Breakers 
Associated with the Relay

items: Reconnect Breaker trip coils.
Close only the circuit breakers associated with the relay.
Adjust the injection parameters to make trip.
Start injection and make sure all breakers are tripped.
Unplug the test set XS92a from the power source.
Remove the test leads from the relay and the test equipment.
Remove the test plugs 1V and 2V from the relay.

Return the relay to the permanent settings as indicated in the maintenance 
 file.
This Completes the Test Procedure.
